Overview

About the HGX B200

NVIDIA HGX B200 is the eight-GPU Blackwell baseboard that set the baseline for Blackwell-generation AI servers. Fifth-generation NVLink connects the GPUs at 1.8 TB/s each, with 1.4 TB of HBM3e across the board.

Its strong FP64 performance makes it a balanced platform for organisations that run both AI training and inference and traditional HPC simulation on the same cluster.

Flexible precision

144 PFLOPS sparse FP4 and 72 PFLOPS dense FP4 for efficient inference.

Training and inference

36 PFLOPS of FP16/BF16 for training and fine-tuning.

Strong FP64

296 TFLOPS of FP64 for scientific and engineering simulation.

1.4 TB HBM3e

Large memory pool for big models and datasets.

Fifth-generation NVLink

1.8 TB/s per GPU and 14.4 TB/s aggregate NVLink bandwidth.

1:1 GPU-to-NIC

Pairs with ConnectX-7 or BlueField-3 for 0.8 TB/s of cluster networking.
